propositions: Raw Ruff C901 diagnostics against src/rebar with threshold 15 must be captured in a committed baseline JSON and compared per function to detect new or increased complexity debt.

The wrapper must reject changes introducing new functions above threshold or increasing existing function scores above their recorded ceilings, while allowing and reporting improvements as stale baseline entries.

Symbol identity must be derived from Python AST (class/function ancestry) to disambiguate equal-named functions in different scopes, and duplicate qualified keys must fail normalization rather than overwrite.

The guarded --update-stale maintenance mode may only lower or remove stale ceilings and must refuse to write if new or increased debt exists, using atomic filesystem writes that leave the target unchanged on failure.

The complexity gate must integrate into make lint, the repository gate must exit zero with active=<count> new=0 increased=0 stale=0 on the committed tree, and all exit-code contracts and JSON schemas must be documented in --help and the runbook.
